clock_dir_past: The Macedonian clock is ADDITIVE ONLY: minutes are counted forward from the
hour already named, through 59, and и ("and") is the only direction word.
reper.net.mk, style guide on writing the time, worked examples "девет и
петнаесет" (9:15), "девет и пол" (9:30) and "дваесет и еден и педесет"
(21:50).  There is no minutes-to-the-hour form: mk.wikipedia's "Предлози во
македонскиот јазик" §Без catalogues every sense of без and names no temporal
clock_fraction_30: reper.net.mk, style guide on writing the time: "девет и пол" is 9:30 -- the
half hour is added to the hour already named, not subtracted from the next.
No quarter-hour word ships: the same guide writes the quarter as "девет и
петнаесет", with the minute spelled out.

The spoken half of the day: CLDR 47 names morning1 (04:00-10:00) "наутро" and morning2
(10:00-12:00) "претпладне", and both are adverbs in their own right -- en.wiktionary.org,
Macedonian entries наутро ("in the morning") and претпладне ("before noon").
clock_meridiem_pm: The spoken half of the day: CLDR 47 names afternoon1 (12:00-18:00) "попладне" and evening1
(18:00-24:00) "навечер", and both are adverbs in their own right -- en.wiktionary.org, Macedonian
entries попладне ("in the afternoon") and навечер ("in the evening") -- so they qualify a named
hour the way "следобед" does in Bulgarian.
